Start by naming the thing being asked about using the problem's own words (you may repeat numbers that appear in the problem), then state the final result as a plain number in digits, with its unit or currency sign if it has one, as the answer. Do not use any other new numbers. Do not use words like "times", "plus", "minus", "divided", "about", "roughly" or "=". Do not show any steps. Do not add anything after the sentence. Example of the style only (not of any answer): "The chairs cost $N in total."</instruction>
